management_notes: Churchill Resources completed a CEO transition in May 2026, appointing Tasheel Jeerh and announcing a concurrent $700,000 private placement to fund continued exploration — a modest raise consistent with pre-resource stage capital needs. Jeerh's appointment alongside a leadership restructuring signals a deliberate push to accelerate strategic growth, though track record under new leadership is short. Prior management delivered material news flow in 2025–2026: the Golden Baie option agreement (TSXV-approved March 2026), a 4,267-metre spring 2026 drilling campaign at Black Raven, and consistent public disclosure across both properties. The large option pool (23.45M options on 316.7M outstanding, ~7.4%) is within junior explorer norms but is notable at this share count. Specific insider ownership percentages are not available from extracted filings. Score held at 3 pending a demonstrated track record under new leadership.
geology_notes: Black Raven Gold-Silver-Antimony Project in central Newfoundland returned 19.23% Sb and 0.73 g/t Au across 1.4m at Frost Cove North from the spring 2026 campaign — an exceptional antimony grade (world-class operations typically run 3–10% Sb). The program completed 23 holes (4,267m) confirming multiple high-grade zones across the structural corridor. Pomley Cove Pond (February 2026) intersected 20 gold-silver-molybdenum-lead-zinc veins within a 150m-wide swarm, adding polymetallic optionality. The Golden Baie option (consolidated March 2026) adds a second antimony-gold corridor, both properties within 100km of the Beaver Brook Antimony Mine — the only primary antimony mine in North America. The August 2023 NI 43-101 technical report pre-dates the consolidated drilling database; no resource estimate exists. Geology is genuinely high-grade and the multi-zone pattern is encouraging, but the absence of a quantified resource keeps this in discovery-stage territory.
capital_notes: 316,681,940 shares issued and outstanding (April 2026 MD&A); 342,756,940 fully diluted. The $700,000 private placement announced May 2026 alongside the CEO transition is a small financing that modestly supplements working capital without materially altering the share structure or dilution profile. Option pool: 23,450,000 (7.4% of outstanding) — strike prices and expiry dates not extracted from MD&A summary table. Warrants: 2,625,000 (minor overhang). No flow-through tranches detected in the April 2026 MD&A or October 2025 annual financials. The high share count (316.7M) is the primary structural constraint: per-share leverage on exploration success is materially compressed relative to peers operating with tighter structures in the 80–150M share range. Until a resource estimate creates a NAV anchor, the share count amplifies downside risk.
catalyst_notes: Final assays from the spring 2026 Black Raven campaign were released in September 2026 and are fully in the market. The primary de-risking catalyst remains a maiden NI 43-101 resource estimate at Black Raven — the current technical report (August 2023) predates the consolidated drilling database, and a resource update would be a material re-rating event. Secondary catalysts: first drill results at Golden Baie (option TSXV-approved March 2026; permitting and site preparation expected to have advanced), any fall 2026 or winter drill program announcement, and continued flow of assay results if additional holes were released. Antimony's critical mineral designation by the US, EU, and Canada sustains a macro tailwind and elevates potential strategic interest. No October 2026 announcements identified. Catalyst calendar is constructive but the key event (resource estimate) is still ahead.
acquisition_notes: No NI 43-101 resource estimate exists, making P/NAV calculation impossible; nav_per_share is null. Antimony's supply-chain context — China controls approximately 70% of global production, with Western governments designating it a critical mineral — meaningfully elevates the strategic acquisition optionality above a standard junior gold explorer. Proximity to Beaver Brook provides a geographic and metallurgical reference for a strategic acquirer seeking North American antimony supply security. The CEO transition to Tasheel Jeerh and the stated objective of accelerating strategic growth could include pursuit of a strategic partnership or offtake agreement, which would be a material positive signal. Without a resource, acquisition value remains speculative; the high share count (316.7M) further reduces per-share leverage in any transaction. Score would rise materially on a maiden resource estimate or a formal strategic partnership announcement.
analyst_summary: Churchill Resources is a pre-resource antimony-gold explorer in central Newfoundland with two properties — Black Raven and Golden Baie — both proximal to the Beaver Brook Antimony Mine, the only primary antimony producer in North America. The spring 2026 Black Raven drilling returned 19.23% Sb at Frost Cove North, confirming world-class antimony grades across a multi-zone structural corridor. The Golden Baie option (TSXV-approved March 2026) consolidates the regional land position and adds a second drill target. A CEO transition in May 2026 (Tasheel Jeerh, with $700K concurrent placement) signals strategic ambition but introduces execution uncertainty pending track record. The blocking constraint is unchanged: no NI 43-101 resource estimate exists, keeping this a speculative exploration position rather than a value-quantifiable investment. Share count (316.7M outstanding) is high for this stage. WATCH: the maiden resource estimate at Black Raven is the catalyst that would trigger a BUY review. The antimony critical-mineral macro tailwind is real and differentiates CRI from a generic junior explorer in a crowded discovery-stage field.
